name: Bodhinyanarama Monastery
tradition: Thai Forest Theravada (Ajahn Chah / Ajahn Sumedho lineage)
technique: Samatha/mindfulness meditation within monastic forest routine
teacherAccess: Monks give daily talks and Q&A (~11:30am) and personal interviews
retreatOptions: 2-7 night standard guest stays; dedicated group retreats at King's Birthday, Labour Weekend, New Year, and occasional weekends
about: A 60-hectare forest monastery active since the 1980s, genuinely open to lay overnight guests rather than monastic-only. Guests keep the Eight Precepts, eat one meal a day, and can join structured group retreats several times a year alongside flexible individual guest stays -- a well-established, credible Theravada option.
schedule: Several fixed retreat weekends per year plus flexible guest stays
foodNotes: One meal a day, no special diets.
workNotes: Not required for short stays; longer Vassa stays expect a work commitment.
